text.zh: 旅程从胸腔正中偏左的心脏开始——这台拳头大小的泵，每天跳动约 10 万次。
text.en: Our journey starts at the heart — a fist-sized pump beating about 100,000 times a day.

text.zh: 心脏自己也要"吃饭"：冠状动脉贴着心脏表面爬行，为心肌供血。它一旦堵塞，就是心肌梗死。
text.en: The heart feeds itself through the coronary arteries hugging its surface — a blockage here means a heart attack.

text.zh: 左心室猛地收缩，血液冲进全身最粗的动脉——主动脉，压力足以把血喷起一米多高。
text.en: With each contraction, blood surges into the aorta — the body's widest artery.

text.zh: 一部分血液向上奔向大脑：颈总动脉在脖子两侧搏动，你现在就能用手指摸到这条生命线。
text.en: Part of the flow races up the common carotid arteries — feel your neck and you'll find this lifeline pulsing.

text.zh: 把氧气送到全身后，血液顺着静脉网"回家"：下半身的血汇入全身最粗的静脉——下腔静脉。
text.en: Oxygen delivered, blood returns home through the veins — the lower body drains into the inferior vena cava.

text.zh: 回到右心的血液缺氧发暗，被送上肺动脉干——这是全身唯一运送"静脉血"的动脉。
text.en: Back at the right heart, oxygen-poor blood is pumped into the pulmonary trunk — the only artery carrying venous blood.

text.zh: 在肺里换上新鲜氧气，血液经肺静脉回到左心，下一次心跳又将启程——这一整圈只需约一分钟。
text.en: Refreshed with oxygen in the lungs, blood returns via the pulmonary veins — the whole loop takes about a minute.
